subject: SIG/RFI: dataflow, retention, KMS and logging evidence request
messages:
From: Alice Cho <alice.cho@peregrinefinance.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@peregrinefinance.com; procurement@peregrinefinance.com
Date: Fri, 02 Mar 2028 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: SIG/ISO/SOC2 RFI — initial evidence requests

Hi Mina,

Thanks for taking this RFI. Attached is the formal SIG questionnaire packet from our risk team (Peregrine_RFI_SIG_2028-03-02.pdf). The areas we need to validate ahead of the vendor short-list:

- Data residency & flow: canonical dataflow diagram showing where customer prompt text, KV cache, and embeddings are stored or transmitted; region-by-region processing.
- Retention & deletion: policy and artifacts showing retention windows (chat logs, embeddings, backups) and deletion workflows (soft-delete, hard-delete, backups).
- Encryption & KMS: whether keys are customer-managed or Redwood-managed; KMS key rotation cadence, BYOK options, and HSM usage if any.
- Logging & audit: sample audit logs for admin and key usage, evidence of immutable log storage for 90+ days.
- SOC 2 / ISO crosswalk: mapping of SIG questions to SOC 2 (CC) / ISO 27001 (Annex A) control IDs and references to existing artifact IDs.

We appreciate a concise mapping file and any exemplar artifacts (e.g., screenshots, exportable logs, redacted manifests). Can you confirm what you can provide by EOD Monday PST? If you have a single evidence manifest we can ingest (CSV or spreadsheet), that would speed our intake.

Attachments: Peregrine_RFI_SIG_2028-03-02.pdf (PDF, 1.8MB)

Regards,
Alice Cho
Senior Risk Manager — Peregrine Financial
-----
Evan Li <evan.li@ciphertrust-consulting.com>
Security assessment lead (supporting Peregrine)
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Cho <alice.cho@peregrinefinance.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Mar 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG/ISO/SOC2 RFI — initial evidence requests

Hi Alice — thanks for the packet, and welcome. I've looped in Karthik (controls lead) and Jasmine (platform ops) to assemble a targeted response. High level: we can provide a single evidence manifest (spreadsheet) that maps SIG questions to our SOC 2 control IDs and ISO 27001 references, plus redacted artifacts for key items (encryption config, KMS audit sample, dataflow diagram).

Quick answers up-front:
- Data residency: Hosted inference processes customer requests in regional clusters and we can map processing to specific cloud regions — see attached dataflow diagram (will share final PDF).
- Retention: Chat transcripts retention default 30 days; embeddings retention configurable per-customer with documented deletion workflows. Backups are snapshot-based — 90-day retention by default, can be extended for Dedicated/Private.
- KMS: By default Redwood manages keys in cloud KMS; we support BYOK for Dedicated/Private customers and have documented key rotation and split-escrow patterns.
- Logs: Admin and KMS events are forwarded to an immutable S3 bucket with lifecycle rules; we can provide a sample (redacted) and the manifest entry pointing to the Drive folder.

We'll assemble the manifest and attach the spreadsheet plus the diagram in our next message. Can you confirm the preferred format for evidence ingest (CSV columns or a HubSpot attachment link)?

Thanks,
Mina
Mina Haddad
Senior Assurance Manager — Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Mar 2028 14:50:00 -07:00
Subject: Draft evidence manifest + mapping (internal)

Mina / Jas — draft for the manifest we've discussed. I pushed an initial spreadsheet to the shared evidence folder and attached a short summary here. Key mapping highlights (this is the short version for Mina to send to Peregrine):

1) Encryption & KMS (SIG section: Crypto & key mgmt)
- Control: Encryption at rest — AES-256; keys stored in cloud KMS (Google Cloud KMS / AWS KMS depending on region). Artifact IDs: ART-ENC-01 (KMS policy screenshot), ART-ENC-02 (key rotation schedule doc).
- BYOK: Supported for Dedicated and Private. Artifact: ART-BYOK-01 (BYOK onboarding playbook).

2) Logging & audit (SIG: Audit & logging)
- Admin and KMS events exported to immutable bucket (WORM-like) with 365-day retention snapshot available. Artifact: ART-LOG-01 (sample audit export, redacted), ART-LOG-02 (logging architecture diagram).

3) Retention & deletion (SIG: Data lifecycle)
- Default product retention: 30 days for chat logs; embeddings by policy. Backups: incremental snapshots retained 90 days. Artifact: ART-RET-01 (data retention policy), ART-RET-02 (deletion runbook).

4) Dataflow & residency (SIG: Data locality)
- Processing occurs in the customer's pinned region for Dedicated/Private; hosted requests route to nearest region with fallback. Artifact: ART-DF-01 (dataflow-diagram-peregrine.pdf).

I'm attaching a small zip of sample artifacts to the internal folder (redwood-sig-evidence-manifest.xlsx is the main). Jasmine: can you add the redacted KMS log and the redacted audit example to the Drive link?

-Karthik
Controls Lead — Redwood Inference
Attachment (internal): redwood-sig-evidence-manifest.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)
From: Alice Cho <alice.cho@peregrinefinance.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Evan Li <evan.li@ciphertrust-consulting.com>; security@peregrinefinance.com; procurement@peregrinefinance.com
Date: Mon, 05 Mar 2028 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG/ISO/SOC2 RFI — initial evidence requests

Mina — thanks for the quick turnaround. A couple of clarifying items from our risk team before you upload artifacts: 

1) KMS key usage logs: we need a sample that shows CustomerKeyID usage and the key-rotation event timestamp (redacted to hide customer identifiers is fine). Can you confirm whether the sample will include CustomerKeyID or if you will provide a mapping table?
2) Deletion proof: for the deletion runbook, we'll need an example entry showing a completed deletion request (timestamp + confirmation hash).
3) ISO mapping: please include Annex A control numbers next to each SIG question in the manifest and indicate whether control is implemented, partially implemented, or planned (we use implemented/partial/planned).

Also, can you provide the evidence manifest as CSV with the following columns: question_id, sig_section, redwood_control_ref, soc2_cc_ref, iso_annex_a_ref, artifact_id, artifact_link, status? If easier, we can accept the spreadsheet but CSV preferred.

We'd like the sample artifacts and manifest by COB Thursday PST.

Best,
Alice
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Cho <alice.cho@peregrinefinance.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>, Evan Li <evan.li@ciphertrust-consulting.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Mar 2028 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG/ISO/SOC2 RFI — initial evidence requests

Hi Alice — confirmed. We're converting the manifest to the CSV schema you requested and populating the ISO Annex A references and status column. Items included in the shared Drive folder (link below) — I will also attach the CSV to HubSpot as a secure file so your intake pipeline can pick it up.

Shared items (redacted where required):
- redwood-sig-evidence-manifest.csv (columns: question_id, sig_section, redwood_control_ref, soc2_cc_ref, iso_annex_a_ref, artifact_id, artifact_link, status)
- dataflow-diagram-peregrine.pdf (redwood network and region annotations)
- ART-ENC-01-kms-policy-screenshot.png (redacted)
- ART-LOG-01-kms-audit-sample.json (redacted events)
- ART-RET-02-deletion-runbook.pdf (includes example request template and confirmation hash format)
- redwood-evidence-index.xlsx (index, internal artifact IDs and short descriptions)

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB-Redwood-Peregrine-Evidence
HubSpot file: https://app.hubspot.com/secure-files/123456/redwood-sig-evidence-manifest.csv

Notes/constraints:
- KMS logs: the sample will show key usage events with a pseudo key ID (KEY-XXXX-REDACTED) and rotation timestamps; we will include a mapping table that shows how to correlate pseudo-IDs to real keys for customers with BYOK under NDA.
- Deletion proof: the runbook example contains a confirmation hash; we cannot publish actual customer hashes — we will provide an example record showing the format and signed confirmation from the operator.

Let us know if you want any additional fields in the CSV. We'll aim to have everything in the Drive and HubSpot by COB Thursday PST (2028-03-09).

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Senior Assurance Manager — Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-sig-evidence-manifest.xlsx (spreadsheet stub); dataflow-diagram-peregrine.pdf (diagram)
